information_flow: The first call receives all common inputs, forms one complete executable policy artifact, and seals the supplied evidence context with indivisible whole-policy authority in one capsule. The final call consumes only that capsule, exercises joint authority over contract-facing and behavior-bearing semantics, establishes end-to-end conformance, and emits one policy.
name: Sealed-Context Unitary Authority Capsule
organization: two-call sequential lineage with one authority-bearing executable capsule and no terminal external evidence edges

calls.objective: Form one complete executable policy artifact from the supplied evidence and place it in an authority-bearing capsule without freezing a separate contract-facing boundary.

Consume encapsulate_unitary_authority as the sole evidence source, exercise indivisible authority over the inherited complete artifact, establish its end-to-end public conformance, and emit one complete policy.
